note: Curated from reading each adapter's source. inventory.test.mjs verifies every listed operation id is a string literal in declaredIn, every adapter directory with a handler.mjs is listed, and every authorization file exists. Listing here is source evidence only; no adapter is enabled, qualified or live.

gateway.current-tool-authority.summary: createCurrentToolAuthority(capabilityAction tool.read).check: verifyCapability (audience meri-gateway, action tool.read, unexpired, scopes in tenant/policy) -> currentRun -> authorizeBusiness (AuthorizationDecision allowed for exact operation@version, actor, policyRevision, requiredGrants, subject scopes within claims) -> authorizeSources (enabled, exact sourceIds) -> currentRun unchanged.

gateway.dispatch-rechecks.summary: createToolDispatch.execute: rejects argument-borne authority, validates contract input, then repeats the current authority check before budget reservation, at effect, at release and after settlement; any change in binding/policy/subject or deadline denies. Budget reserve/settle; uncertain on failure.

gateway.skill-installation.summary: Skill route only: createSelectedSkillGatewayMount re-reads the native-qualified installation receipt (handler sourceSha256 measured) before and after every delivery; createInstalledRuntimeCatalog admits only sideEffect none / approvalBoundary none descriptors.

adapter.authority-coherence.summary: Adapter-local re-validation of the dispatcher-supplied authority object (RunBinding/CapabilityClaims/AuthorizationDecision coherence, audience, tool.read, decision allowed for this operation, decisionId = subject.authorizationDecisionId, policy revision, deadline, cancellation). Not an authorization owner; it refuses incoherent input.
